class.description: Costmap layer that encodes terrain traversability derived from an elevation map. Slope angle per cell is mapped to a variable cost: 0–5° : transparent (NO_INFORMATION — preserves flat-ground obstacle markings) 5–10° : cost 10 10–20° : cost 30 20–30° : cost 80 30–35° : cost 120 (passable but expensive) >35° : LETHAL_OBSTACLE (254) This layer runs AFTER ObstacleLayer so it can correct false-positive obstacle markings caused by sloped terrain surfaces seen by the LiDAR.
